purpose: To surrender a Director Identification Number (DIN) by making an application to the Central Government.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Make an application in Form DIR-5 to surrender the DIN.
Submit a declaration that you have never been appointed as a director in any company.
Submit a declaration that the DIN has never been used for filing of any document with any authority.
The Central Government verifies e-records before deactivating the DIN.
checklist: Declaration that the applicant has never been appointed as a director in any company
Declaration that the DIN has never been used for filing of any document with any authority
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
